exercise.title: Translate
exercise.task:
Translate into German.

1. Are you tired?
   Context: One person, informal
2. Does he have time?
3. Are we ready?

skills.name: incidental vocabulary
skills.success_criterion: Put the finite verb first in a neutral German yes/no question.

input.learner_response:
Item 1: "Bist du mude?"
Item 2: "Hat er ... (I don't know the word for time)?"
Item 3: "Sind wir ...? (same)"

skills.name: incidental vocabulary

success_criteria: Put the finite verb first in a neutral German yes/no question.

lesson.objective: Put the finite verb first in a neutral German yes/no question.
lesson.recap: Put the finite verb first in a neutral German yes/no question.

observations.rationale: All three questions put the finite verb first; the missing content words do not obscure the target structure.

output.reply: The missing words are **Zeit** (time) and **bereit** (ready). In standard spelling, **müde** uses ü.
output.summary: In this translation exercise, demonstrated finite-verb-first order in all three German yes/no questions. Did not know the words for “time” and “ready”; wrote “mude” without the umlaut in item 1.
